name: Till Wiechmann
headline: Co-Founder & CEO at Tanso - Sustainability & Compliance Software for Industry
summary:
At Tanso, we enable industrial companies to turn sustainability performance into a competitive advantage. Our software suite combines Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF), Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) and ESG data management for various reporting standards (ESRS, VSME, GRI). The Tanso Platform helps businesses to optimize the ROI of their sustainability strategy while automating regulatory compliance processes.

We are scaling fast and working with leading industrial companies to transform sustainability from a compliance burden into a business opportunity. If you’re interested in partnering with us, reach out to marketing@tanso.de

We’re also growing our team—join us in shaping the future of industrial sustainability: https://www.tanso.de/en/karriere

company.name: Tanso
company.tagline: Carbon accounting & ESG data management software for manufacturing companies
company.description:
Tanso is the ESG and carbon accounting software that industrial companies in DACH rely on to compete and comply in carbon-sensitive sectors. The Tanso platform enables companies to meet customer requests and regulatory requirements in sustainability, ensuring data management to the highest standards through structured, audit-proof processes. With TÜV Rheinland-certified methodology, Tanso is trusted by over 300 industrial customers across automotive, mechanical engineering, food and chemicals to strengthen their competitive position in sustainability and ESG performance.

More information about Tanso: www.tanso.de
